title: What Level of Use Is This?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify eight teacher behaviors by CBAM level of use, from nonuse to renewal.

educational.topic: What Level of Use Is This?
learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight teacher behaviors by CBAM level of use, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The eight levels of use, from the section "CBAM, Completed" in Chapter 18.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: A teacher uses it daily but follows each step with the guide and often loses track. Which level?
Three teachers compare dashboards weekly and redesign the morning together. Which level?
commonMisconceptions: Higher levels are better in all cases
Level of use and stage of concern are the same
A teacher who uses the tool every day is at a high level
assessmentOpportunities: A teacher uses it daily but follows each step with the guide and often loses track. Which level?
Three teachers compare dashboards weekly and redesign the morning together. Which level?
Are level of use and stage of concern the same?
Is a higher level always better?

controls.name: 8 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the levels; two tries per behavior.

controls.name: Show descriptions
controls.description: Opens a table of the levels and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
